youtube.title: What a Ghost Pepper Does Inside Your Body
youtube.description: There is no fire. A chili molecule called capsaicin just tricks your heat sensor TRPV1 into screaming – and it is waiting at the exit the next morning. Animated comedy; characters are made up, the receptor is real (Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine 2021). Not medical advice.

tiktok.caption: There is no fire. Your heat sensor just got scammed by a molecule in a fedora. 🌶️ And it comes back for the exit.
